hosted_capital_observations.join: Capital pool name -> runtime binding capital_pool_id -> ledger binding_id; three ledger initial_cash values are 100000.0.
hosted_capital_observations.pnl_source: Inherited 2026-11-12 audit values 12880.116 / 4730 / 207, not freshly measured PnL; no new hosted scoring or activation claim.

acceptance_evidence.2: Formula endpoint v2, v1 version-history entry, operator decision record; legacy v1 exact digest and BFF snapshot reader tests.

scope_extension_rationale: The scoped scorer had no capital/period provenance because telemetry discarded it, and snapshot identity/BFF snapshot admission hardcoded v1. Minimal changes to paper event production, telemetry projection, snapshot identity and BFF snapshot admission are necessary to make the requested production flow work; no allocation parameters or execution authority changed.
